title: A Map for Two Kinds of Places
synopsis: All five friends make a separate imaginary map of Button Town and place it beside the completed Book of Little Sounds.
continuity_state: Before: Button Town has several agreed imaginary features; Amy’s real yellow map still has the corrected orchard bend; the ticket and other pretend papers are at Blue Door Cottage; Ben’s completed sound book is on the low Story House shelf. After: At Story House all five children draw a complete separate Button Town pretend map with Doorway Tree, bakery, post office, Lake Teacup and the Little Quiet Place. Grandma May places that map, the visitor ticket and remaining paper letters in the brown envelope on the same low shelf beside Ben’s blue book. Todd already has his delivered card. Amy keeps the accurate real yellow map at home. All friends return home safely; no event is pending.

related_resources.reason: The story keeps a real route map distinct from a game drawing; AAP shared-reading guidance is general context for naming and discussing pictures.
Shared pretend map-making is editorially related to collaborative make-believe examples in the AAP play report.
